iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. OpenFA Mauna Surveillance Craft Type5 MN0A small scout remaster. Preserve this unusual craft as one UPRIGHT thick chamfered rectangular SLAB of opaque grey metal: broad face roughly square, width slightly greater than height; thickness seen edge-on about0.4 of full height. It is the actual spacecraft body, not a billboard attached to another hull, NOT a flat horizontal carrier, aircraft or winged spaceship. Interrupted top edge with a few low separate rectangular crown tabs and real open gaps, not pointed spikes; four low tabs are a plausible authored interpretation of the pixel silhouette. Two small warm rusty-brown/copper opaque lower tabs project below the body, non-emissive. Blue-grey opaque surface fields and sparse fitted service panels on broad metal faces, no literal windows or glass. Exact face panel layout/crown count below source resolution is interpretive. No big wings, turrets, cockpit, glowing engines, thruster flames, antenna dish, landing legs, cargo boxes, extra hull or support stand. Plain utilitarian Mauna metal construction, medium/dark neutral steel grey, subdued blue-grey fields, oxidized dark-alloy recesses and tiny warm lower details; no architecture ornament and no concrete texture. Few seated maintenance panels, small fasteners and shallow seams; large quiet surfaces WITHOUT dense rectangular panel grids. Material-appropriate restrained use wear: irregular grime around joins, small scuffs, scratches, stains and dents without muddying silhouette. High-quality believable game remaster, one coherent upright slab shown in large three-quarter view and smaller broad-face and edge-on views, consistent form/counts.
